mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which may potentiate ezetimibe's effects on lipid metabolism and increase myopathy risk; ezetimibe may increase cholesterol gallstone risk which is additive with thiazide-induced metabolic changes.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; counsel on muscle symptoms; consider potassium-sparing agent or increased dietary potassium if hypokalemia develops.
